seo.title: Asthi Visarjan — Eternal Repos
seo.description: A gentle note on Asthi Visarjan, the immersion of ashes: what it means and how it unfolds.

hero.heading: Asthi Visarjan
hero.body: The last journey a family makes for someone they love: giving them back to the river.

whatItIs.body: In the Hindu tradition, the family gives the asthi to a flowing river, with prayers, trusting that it carries their loved one onward. It is a farewell, and a quiet act of love.

items.title: Gathering
items.text: The family gently gathers the asthi, a few days after the cremation.

items.title: The river
items.text: Most families go to the Ganga, at Haridwar or Prayagraj. Some choose a river nearer home.

items.title: The prayers
items.text: A priest guides a short puja, with water offered in remembrance.

items.title: Letting go
items.text: The asthi is given to the water, with flowers and a moment of stillness.

steps.note: Every family follows its own customs. Your priest and elders will know what feels right, and there is no hurry.

close.body: If you would like someone beside you, we are here. Take your time.
